info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Logistics Shipments Labels-v1-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Labels API allows users to retrieve labels for their logistics shipments efficiently. This endpoint provides access to detailed label information, which is essential for tracking and managing shipments throughout the logistics process. Typical consumers include logistics managers, shipping coordinators, and system integrators seeking to automate and streamline their shipping operations. By utilizing this API, businesses can improve their shipping documentation and ensure accurate delivery tracking.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a shipping label for a specific shipment. Use this operation to obtain the necessary label for shipping your package, which can be printed and affixed to the parcel.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the shipment label. It contains necessary data to generate and retrieve the label based on the provided shipment parameters.
